scope: Fixed exploratory word-to-trajectory study. Acquisition and evaluation are by CMU catalogue subject ID. Identity across IDs is unknown.
target: One 0.6-second window per eligible original C3D. Check 120 Hz, mm, +Z up using head/heel separation and available screen metadata. Require complete named marker data in selected windows. Never impute missing samples or replace excluded recordings.
registration: Define horizontal forward from last minus first available pelvis centre, median over up to 12 samples at each end. Require at least 0.25 m net displacement. Right = forward cross lab +Z. Pelvis is mean of four waist landmarks. Use one orientation per whole clip. Within middle half of source time and with >=36 frames on both sides, take earliest maximum of right-minus-left heel forward separation with complete source landmark data at the 25 output instants. This target-derived phase registration fixes a convention unavailable as a prospective cue. Downsample at every 3rd native frame, no time warp. +X right, +Y forwards, +Z up. Body landmarks relative to same-time pelvis; pelvis trajectory relative to first displayed pelvis. Site order and physical definitions in schema.json.
input: Two shared action tokens walk and run. Map only exact supported plain catalogue label variants, preserving source wording in split. No recording, subject, measurements or initial pose supplied at inference; deterministic, one sequence per token.
model: Action embedding with 8 coordinates; fixed normalised linear time plus Fourier features sin/cos at 1,2,3,4 cycles per window. Concatenate per frame, two tanh dense layers of width 48 and linear 57-coordinate readout. Center targets using train-only pooled mean across recordings/time per output channel; use 100 mm loss scale for all channels. Re-anchor predicted translation to zero at its first frame. Minimise mean squared error equally over all 57 coordinates, all 25 times and training clips, full batch Adam lr .006, 500 updates, seed 3429, no dropout, save final model. No hyperparameter selection or repeated assessment.
controls: Same decoder, seed, updates and clips with a single constant token; same decoder with train tokens shuffled across recordings by numpy default_rng(11273) preserving counts. Evaluate both with original trial labels. Separate simple class-mean aligned training trajectory and unconditional training mean. No held-out data in parameter or phase-policy selection.
outcomes: Primary mean Euclidean pelvis-relative site error (mm; mean over 25 times and 18 sites). Arithmetic mean over trials within a subject and mean over subjects. Primary success strictly smaller error than conditional mean, unconditional decoder and shuffled decoder. Secondary pelvis path Euclidean error and end forward travel signed/absolute error, mean body landmark speed absolute difference (mm/s), per-class, per-subject and trial outcomes. Report no population CI for three held-out IDs. Report prepared/missing per original frozen split.
timing: Freeze split, protocol and schema before fetching any C3D on this study. Fetch train first; lock final parameters and all baselines before assessment acquisition. Never fetch reserve. No tuning using assessment. Acquisition/metadata checks are permitted; record failures.
